sources.supportingExcerpt: citizens of the People’s Republic of China (including passport holders of Hong Kong and Macao SAR) may enter and stay in Georgia without visa

policies.title: Hong Kong SAR ordinary passports: 30-day Georgian tourist waiver
policies.summary: Georgia's Foreign Ministry directly includes Hong Kong SAR passport holders in its 30-day visa-free tourist rule, corroborated by the HKSAR passport authority.
conditions: Applies to a Hong Kong SAR passport holder visiting Georgia for tourism for up to 30 days.
Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service and other document categories remain outside this ordinary short-visitor finding.
Entry remains subject to Georgia's border, admissibility, security and public-order rules.

policies.title: Georgia MFA live ordinary-passport country results: advance visitor visa
policies.summary: For each named ordinary passport, Georgia's live MFA eligibility response says a visa is needed and no electronic visa is available. The controlling law places non-electronic visa issuance with the MFA, missions and consular offices abroad.
conditions: The live country results for Nicaragua, Venezuela, Nauru and the Syrian Arab Republic each return NeedVisa true and CanGetVisa false. The result is used with the application's Ordinary passport selection only.

This is the ordinary-passport, short visitor baseline without relying on a separate valid third-country visa or residence-permit exception. The response marks a supporting-document field; any document-conditioned exception is outside this passport-only policy.

The law assigns regular visa issuance to the MFA, Georgian diplomatic missions and consular offices abroad; its electronic route is separately issued through the MFA special webpage. The live result expressly denies that electronic route for this cohort.
Issuance and entry remain subject to the statutory visa application, refusal, security, public-order, funds, insurance, border and territorial rules.
